answer: Require every agent identity to sit under a verified organization that posts a $10,000 surety bond. Auditors split each application through a prism of three checks: legal registration, a banked surety, and live operations. One proven fake drops the whole org to its nadir: all its agents suspended and the bond slashed. Each org is re-verified every 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 100 shell orgs, burning $1,200,000 in bonds and incorporation fees plus 180 days of paperwork. The bond stains like pigment: it cannot be rinsed off by dissolving the shell.
